marketing_wrapper: Light. No device frame and no backdrop: each image is a full-bleed real screen with the marketing caption styled as one of the app's own chunky 3D buttons (orange, purple, green, blue, red) occupying the bottom ~20%. Roughly 80% real UI per image. 05 is a full-bleed isometric scene (in-app conversation mode), not pure marketing art.

typography.display: Custom heavy rounded geometric display, lowercase, for captions and the streak '3' / 'day streak' (consistent with Duolingo's Feather Bold; name not verified from pixels alone)
typography.body: custom - a rounded, squarish DIN-like sans (consistent with DIN Round) for prompts, options and course names; not SF
typography.numerals: rounded (heavy rounded display numeral for streak count; rounded small numerals for energy '25')
typography.weights: Bold prompts ('Select the correct image'), regular/medium for options; heavy display only for celebration and captions
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case in UI, all-lowercase captions; character name tag 'EDDY' in caps; normal tracking

palette.accent_strategy: Semantic per-system hues on white: green for progress and correct, blue for selection and audio, orange for streak, pink for energy, purple for highlighted keyword; many hues but each mapped to a meaning. Characters add per-content colour.
palette.source: palette.json 01/06 (#ffffff dominant, #ff800b orange), 04 (#23b1f2 blue), 03 (#30d1a7 green caption), 05 (#dd524b red caption); progress green and text grey matched visually

shape.radius_language: large ~14-16pt on option cards, word chips and buttons; circles for day checks; consistent everywhere
shape.borders_shadows: 2pt light-grey borders plus a thicker solid bottom border that makes every card, chip and button read as a pressable 3D slab; no blur shadows
shape.materials: flat with faux-3D extruded edges; isometric illustrated world in 05

density: low: one task per screen, big tap targets, 2x2 option grid with wide gutters
layout: Lesson: close X + green progress bar + energy count on top, bold prompt, character with speech bubble, answer area (word bank or 2x2 image grid), primary button pinned bottom. Celebration: character + giant numeral + week row.
navigation: No tab bar in these frames (all are modal lesson/celebration states). Close X top-left; 'Courses' list with plain grey title and chevron rows.
imagery_and_icons: Flat vector illustration with soft shading; full character cast (Duo owl, Lily-style people, bear); flag tiles; custom filled icons (speaker, energy battery); isometric scene for conversation practice
signature_visual_move: Everything tappable is a thick-bottomed rounded slab, so the whole UI reads as physical buttons, and the store captions copy that button.
tells_present: Streak counter plus flame (the original, illustrated rather than emoji)

direction_fit.why: Characters with speech bubbles appear in lesson and celebration states and speak in a motivating voice ('I'm off to brag about your streak'); the 3D slab button language matches the reconstructed record.

notes: The multi-hue palette stays legible because each hue is tied to one system (progress, selection, streak, energy). The streak screen is the canonical source of the 'streak + flame' habit-template tell; a clone copying it reads as Duolingo pastiche.
